# NEW 2026-11-20 v6.7 batch 11 fs-frontier1, the settlement of a conquered crown. Generated by gen_frontier.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# The vanilla hooks are added to, never replaced (the mod's form, oe_osman_restoration.txt). REBELTAG: the empire, not
# a rebel state keeping the tag. Engine probe P1: does an annexation in a peace treaty fire these? (design 5.2)
# fired before the annexation happens; root = the annexer, scope:target = the country being annexed
on_military_annex = { on_actions = { oe_fs_before_annex } }
on_annex = { on_actions = { oe_fs_before_annex } }
oe_fs_before_annex = {
    trigger = {
        current_year >= 1200
        tag = BYZ is_rebel_country = no
        oe_fs_annexer_ok = yes
        exists = scope:target
        scope:target = { oe_fs_target_ok = yes }
    }
    effect = {
        scope:target = { save_scope_as = oe_fs_tgt }
        oe_fs_register = { via = 1 }
    }
}
# fired after the annexation has happened: the batch is confirmed (oe_fs_via 11)
on_military_annexed = { on_actions = { oe_fs_after_annex } }
on_annexed = { on_actions = { oe_fs_after_annex } }
oe_fs_after_annex = {
    trigger = {
        current_year >= 1200
        tag = BYZ is_rebel_country = no
        has_variable = oe_fs_cur
        NOT = { has_variable = oe_fs_check }
        NOT = { has_variable = oe_fs_pending }
    }
    effect = { oe_fs_confirm = yes }
}
